1.consolidated_definition: Masturbarse un hombre. Me pasé el botellón vacío por las pelotas y me gustó. Más que cuando me raspé una casqueta con conditioner. Y aquella pendejá sí que fue deliciosa déjame decirte.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Masturbarse un hombre: to engage in self-pleasure; specifically, to experience a heightened sense of satisfaction or enjoyment, often accompanied by a vivid recollection of a past event or encounter, such as having consumed an empty bottle of liquor and subsequently experiencing a pleasurable sensation, similar to that felt when one has used conditioner on their hair.
